Where you’ll be
Vågan, Nordland, Norway
Midnight sun in the summer, northern lights in autumn and winter, walking distance to Golf course, Beaches and amazing mountain hiking. Likewise, it is a quiet place, secluded and you can enjoy the silence if you want. Short drive to Henningsvær and Svolvær if you want more city life. If you drive west, you are not far from Surf on Unstad, Hauklandstrand, countless mountain hikes and mighty nature.
